Sorry for being late on the episode this week folks! Things have been hectic. I just started a new job, Caleb is currently eating cheese, and Geno is busy being a legend. So, I'm gonna get to editing tomorrow morning and get it out as soon as possible, preferably before Monday.

-Juice
By the way folks, if you haven't noticed, we have upgraded to proper professional broadcast levels of sound quality the last two episodes. That's gonna be our excuse on why they're late. Mhm. 😌
This week's episode is also going to be late, but we're working to get back on track. It's been another wild week here in the Studios of Hammpions
